profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Passionate and highly skilled professional with more than eight years of web development experience, including two and a half years of working on an enterprise level site. Very versed in communicating between teams from both technical and non-technical backgrounds. Recently lead a small team of four developers in the inception and delivery of a web application that allowed salespeople to personalize their customers’ experiences. Interested in new opportunities in development and remote work.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Owner and developer at Zullo Tech

- Managed client relations
- Developed several different websites
- Created and modified new features for existing sites

positions.title: Associate Engineer in System Design and Strategy
positions.description:
The sole developer on the IAM and SDG teams.

- Created custom built dashboards for reporting
- Programed specialized internal tools for specific team functions
- Developed custom built RESTful APIs to expand out our system platforms
- Worked with multiple different teams within T-mobile and through T-mobile's vendors

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
Was the main driver in the development and relaunch of www.bargreen.com.

- Identified issues and problems with the previous website, including internal networking problems and reliance on an outdated ERP system, all of which prevented the site from being fully functional for one day a week
- Developed a new website that was more separate from the company's ERP system and company network in order to allow the site to be functional 24/7 as well as prevent further connection issues
- Worked with the Magento framework in order to build a new site that was integrated with the Lawson ERP system and maintained the functionality of the previous site
- Assisted the marketing team in developing an integrated marketing strategy that capitalized on Bargreen's strengths but also enhanced those strengths using the website and other technological tools
- Built an order processing application that replaced the job of two people processing a max of two hundred orders a day with a program that processed one-hundred fifty orders in fifteen minutes
- Migrated the internal employee intranet to an external host in order to allow company staff to access the site outside of the company's network
- Successfully relaunched redskitchen.com, a site owned by Bargreen, but had been abandoned for over a month
- Created systems of documentation and automated testing using WATIR (Web Application Testing in Ruby)

projects.title: PUP Dog Rescue: Virtually Adopt a Dog Feature - GiveCamp 2015
projects.description: Worked on a six person team to allow potential donors the opportunity to sponsor or virtually adopt a dog from PUP (People United For Pets). This custom feature was integrated into an existing website (www.pupdogrescue.org) during Microsoft's GiveCamp event. GiveCamp is an event where developers and other techies come together to build great things for non-profits. Our team developed this using HTML, CSS, jQuery, and Laravel, a PHP framework. It utilized the Paypal API and helped to establish a backend so that PUP volunteers can more easily manage the content on their website.

projects.title: Mentor Match
projects.description: Pair programmed Mentor Match, a web app that allowed an admin to pair students and mentors together.  Consisting of three different dashboards, we designed the app for use by Codefellows faculty.  We utilized the framework of Ruby on Rails and utilized several different Ruby Gems, along with a couple of jQuery libraries, the product of which can be seen on our github repository page.
